# symbol-table: punctuation lookup sets passed to contains, IndexAny, strpbrk or bound to a name.
# every element is distinct and no alphanumeric appears, so the value carries no token payload.
# known gap: a character set spelled out as a string is reported (`ALLOWED = "abc...xyz0123456789-_."`,
# a base64 or base32 alphabet, the unreserved characters of a URL). the same bytes are the dummy
# token test suites carry, and the property test of the exemption layer keeps every window of the
# alphabet `a..zA..Z0..9-_` reported, so a set cannot be told from a token by its bytes.
DELIMITERS = "()[]{}<>,;:?!&*=|.~^%"
const delimiters = "()[]{}<>,;:?!&*=|.~^%/"
const SEPARATORS = '()[]{}<>,;:?!&*=|.~^%@';
let delimiter = is_any(b"()[]{}<>,;:?!&*=\\'\"`|.", byte);
const char *OPERATORS = "+-*/%=<>!&|^~?:,;()[]{}";
idx := strings.IndexAny(input, "!#$%&'*+-.^_`|~:/?@[]")
table = str.maketrans("", "", "!#$%&*+-./:;<=>?@^_|~")
SHELL_META='|&;<>()$*?[]#~=%!{}^'
"reserved": "!*'();:@&=+$,/?#[]%-._~",
url_reserved: ":/?#[]@!$&'()*+,;=%-._~"
